digest.component_or_area: CLI mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, create, transition, etc.)
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, archive, etc.) currently exit silently on success, making successful writes and idempotent no-ops indistinguishable on stdout, causing agents to issue follow-up store reads and misinterpret silent results as failures.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must print a one-line kubectl-style confirmation on successful write (e.g., 'linked <src> -> <target>', 'tagged <alias>: +<tag>') and 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent no-ops, both exiting 0.

Global --quiet and --output json flags must be extracted at the top-level router before verb dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands).

Consumed seam return values (e.g., add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; confirmation output rides in a parallel channel only where the existing return cannot distinguish write-vs-noop.

link's REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical before and after, including under --quiet, with exactly one stdout result per invocation in text mode (record only, no extra confirmation line).

Existing per-verb confirmations (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared contract preserving all prior-line data (e.g., transition's UNBLOCKED ids moved into the new line); reopen gains a confirmation line.
